{{Top|leg}}
The '''Time of Learning''' was the period of time that [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] used to learn new [[Dathomir Magic|spells]]. [[Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] learned new spells under the guidance of a [[Mentor (Dathomir)|Mentor]], and learning a new spell typically took at least ten [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of intense training.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
